rating_definitions.substantial: Evidence-rich explanation and primary independent corroboration with verified physical site reading
rating_definitions.developing: Concrete explanatory material with unresolved primary, interpretive or physical-context gap
rating_definitions.sparse: Single mediated excerpt, uncertain interpretation or underdetermined physical site link
rating_definitions.missing: Site knowledge or archival evidence not sufficient to support field interpretation
